messages:
zoe (Marketing): Dropped the near-final blog draft in the doc — need hero headline lock, benchmark phrasing (med/p95), gated webinar + "flightdeck" kit CTA, and HubSpot + Mixpanel routing. Soft-publish Thu AM. Copy freeze today.
mike (Product): Reading now. Strong preference for med/p95 numbers in the subhead and a short test-note in the appendix. No '2x' style claims in hero. I'll paste exact figures.
anya (Growth): CTA plan: primary = 'Request a demo' (sales), hero secondary = 'Get the Flightdeck kit' (gated). For the first 72h split traffic 60/40 demo/kit. Kit should be 3-item: 1-page results, mini-runbook, results.csv.
jia (Design): Uploaded two hero comps: flightdeck-console.png and sparkline-inline.png. Mobile-first: flightdeck-console wins. Suggest one-line headline and a tighter subhead with numbers. Will tweak after copy lock.
linda (Growth Ops): HubSpot wiring plan: lists = ["fd_launch_demo","fd_launch_kit"]; utm_campaign=flightdeck-q2. Form embed I'll drop in the doc: <!-- HS form -->
<form data-portal="54321" data-form="fd123">...</form>. Scoring: +50 demo, +35 kit, threshold 75 to SDR. Calendly for demo confirmation.
zoe (Marketing): Mike, can you add the appendix with test harness (synthbench v5, 8xA100, seq=1024) and a short methodological note?
mike (Product): Done: added appendix line: "Median down 48%; p95 down 31% vs baseline under synthbench v5 (see appendix)." Also added a footnote on workload.
anya (Growth): I'll draft two headline variants for A/B: A) "Lower p95 for production" B) "Predictable tail latency for real workloads" — leaning A for clarity.
jia (Design): Variant A fits visual lock better. Small copy ask: subhead should say 'real-world p95' not generic 'faster'. Updated mock.
linda (Growth Ops): Mixpanel events to emit: article_view, kit_requested, demo_requested. I'll paste tracking params in the doc and wire the HS lists + workflows. Kit -> autoresponder with gated link; demo -> Calendly + SDR notification.
preview-bot: staging preview scheduled for 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z for thread 5867894321
zoe (Marketing): Timeline recap: copy freeze 17:00 PT, design lock 18:00 PT, HS wiring 20:00 PT, staging preview 09:00 UTC Thu. If you edit the doc drop a short note here. Any blockers?
mike (Product): One editorial plea: include a short enterprise-facing paragraph comparing latency/cost vs a common open baseline (no vendor names) to help procurement readers. Added a sentence in the doc.
anya (Growth): I'll build CTA variants and tracking tags. Also recommending a gated 30-min post-launch office hours for kit users.
jia (Design): I'll sign off visuals once headline and CTAs are locked.
linda (Growth Ops): HubSpot forms and lists created; I'll run a test submit and report back in the doc.
zoe (Marketing): Great — I'll run a final editorial sweep after the test submit and queue the preview. Thanks team :rocket:
